messages:
maya: Quick pattern-hunt retro — noticed a cluster of similar incidents over Feb–Mar: KV cache misses causing tail latency, and a couple of pod OOMs tied to long-tail sequence batching. Opening this thread to consolidate postmortem follow-ups, owners, and timelines. Who can take primary ownership for the KV telemetry and for the canary of the batching change?

sam: +1. I can lead KV telemetry. I'll instrument prefix-miss rate and add a simple alert.

luca: The OOMs line up with the batch-router sending very long sequences into the same worker; I have a draft smart-batching patch that limits max batch seq variance. On staging it cut p95 mem by ~15%. Need an owner to run a controlled canary.

priya: From ops: several postmortems didn't have clear owners or ETAs — that's adding to recurrence. I've started a short tracker below; please confirm ownership and ETA.

maya: Action checklist (pasteable):
- A1 | Owner: sam | ETA: 2024-05-10 | Task: instrument prefix-miss metric, add alert, correlate with model/version
- A2 | Owner: luca | ETA: 2024-05-03 | Task: deploy smart-batching canary (10% traffic), gather memory and latency traces
- A3 | Owner: priya | ETA: 2024-05-17 | Task: reconcile open postmortems, mark recurrence risk, assign owners for any repeats
- A4 | Owner: ops-bot | ETA: 2024-04-30 | Task: run monthly recurrence-scan job and emit top patterns to this channel

sam: I'll start A1 today. PR tracking: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-telemetry (will add tests + dashboard panels).

luca: Canary rollout plan:
- step 1: deploy patch to canary pool with extended tracing
- step 2: 10% traffic for 48h, monitor mem p50/p95, error rate, routing latency
- step 3: rollback if mem p95 reg > 2% or error spike > 0.5%
I'll post the canary config as a Gist once ready.

maya: Prioritize A1 + A2; those are most likely to reduce recurrence this quarter. Also we should run a quick tag co-occurrence on recent incidents to confirm top root-cause clusters (cache-miss, routing-mismatch, quant-regressions).

priya: I'll update the postmortem template to include: recurrence-risk (low/medium/high), explicit owner field, target ETA, and whether there's a workaround. That should reduce missing owners going forward.

ops-bot: monthly recurrence scan finished: 7 patterns detected in last 90 days. Top 3: KV cache misses (17% of grouped incidents), routing mismatches (12%), quantization regressions (8%). Full CSV uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/recurrence-scans/2024-03-scan.csv

sam: Good signal. I'll instrument a dashboard for the KV cluster and add a panel for prefix-miss by model/version.

luca: logging snippet from staging when we reproduced the OOMs:
```
2024-03-21T12:12:02Z runtime[pid=2345] OOM mem=24.6GB req=512 tokens route=long
2024-03-21T12:12:03Z kvcache miss prefix="user:prompts:..."
```
Sharing this in the canary run so we can correlate traces.

maya: Meeting: reconvene next Wed 10:00am PT. Agenda: A1 status, A2 canary results, template update verification. @sam @luca @priya please update the tracker by EOD Friday with current progress and links to dashboards/PRs.

priya: Will update the tracker and ping owners today. :calendar: 

sam: Will send initial dashboard link and PR before EOD.

luca: I'll spin up the canary and post config by tomorrow morning.

maya: Thanks everyone — let's try to close 2 of these items this sprint. If anything blocks, call it out here or in #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
